Entry.en-US:
You are {CHARACTER-SHORT-0}, first ruler of {PLAYER-1}, and no one here yet knows what kind of ruler you will be.
"We followed you on faith," says one of the elders who walked the whole road with your people. "The older kingdoms are known by what their rulers are - the pious, the cunning, the merciless. Of you we can say only that you brought us this far."
True enough, and not yet enough. Your young nation awaits its first command. May the gods of {PLAYER-1} smile upon you.
